name: scrapeHtml
description: Retrieve the raw HTML of a page. Browser rendering and a screenshot are optional.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: URL of the page to scrape. Must include the protocol (https://).

arguments.name: blockResources
arguments.desc: Blocks images, fonts, and stylesheets from loading. Speeds up scraping and reduces bandwidth usage.

arguments.name: browserRendering
arguments.desc: Controls whether the page is loaded in a browser. Leave it out to load the page without a browser first and switch to a browser automatically if the request is blocked. Set true to always load the page in a browser, which JavaScript-heavy sites, SPAs, and pages that load content dynamically need. Set false to never use a browser.

arguments.name: geoCode
arguments.desc: Two-letter country code to load the page from, such as us or gb. Defaults to the United States.

arguments.name: maxAge
arguments.desc: Serves a cached result of the same request when it is newer than this age, in milliseconds, such as 86400000 for 1 day. Up to 604800000 (7 days). 0, the default, always scrapes fresh. A cached result costs the same tokens as the original scrape.

arguments.name: maxRetries
arguments.desc: Maximum number of retries for the request. Omit for no limit.

arguments.name: screenshot
arguments.desc: Also captures a screenshot of the rendered page as a base64-encoded PNG: full captures the entire scroll height, top captures the first viewport, and <width>x<height> sets the viewport size in pixels with an optional -<zoom> percent, such as 1280x800 or 1920x1080-75. Width and height range from 100 to 3840, zoom from 25 to 300. Setting it forces browser rendering. Leave it out for no screenshot.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.desc: Maximum seconds to wait for the scrape before the request times out, from 1 to 330. Increase for slow or complex pages. Defaults to 300.

arguments.name: waitForSelector
arguments.desc: Waits until a specific CSS selector or text appears on the page before returning it, such as #results. Up to 500 characters. Useful for content that loads asynchronously after the initial page load.

arguments.name: warmStart
arguments.desc: Opens the site's home page first to warm the session before loading the target URL. Useful for sites that expect a normal browsing session before deeper pages.

arguments.name: maxRetries

arguments.name: screenshot
arguments.desc: Screenshot area: full captures the entire scroll height (the default), top captures the first viewport, and <width>x<height> sets the viewport size in pixels with an optional -<zoom> percent, such as 1280x800 or 1920x1080-75. name: scrapeJson
description: Extract structured JSON from a page using a natural-language prompt. Append Json Schema: and a JSON schema to shape the output.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: URL of the page to scrape. Must include the protocol (https://).

arguments.name: blockResources
arguments.desc: Blocks images, fonts, and stylesheets from loading. Speeds up scraping and reduces bandwidth usage.

arguments.name: browserRendering
arguments.desc: Controls whether the page is loaded in a browser. Leave it out to load the page without a browser first and switch to a browser automatically if the request is blocked. Set true to always load the page in a browser, which JavaScript-heavy sites, SPAs, and pages that load content dynamically need. Set false to never use a browser.

arguments.name: geoCode
arguments.desc: Two-letter country code to load the page from, such as us or gb. Defaults to the United States.

arguments.name: html
arguments.desc: Returns the raw HTML of the scraped page in the response. On by default; set false to leave it out.

arguments.name: maxAge
arguments.desc: Serves a cached result of the same request when it is newer than this age, in milliseconds, such as 86400000 for 1 day. Up to 604800000 (7 days). 0, the default, always scrapes fresh. A cached result costs the same tokens as the original scrape.

arguments.name: maxRetries
arguments.desc: Maximum number of retries for the request. Omit for no limit.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.desc: Description of the data shape you want back, for example fields like title, price, and rating. The prompt only parses the scraped content; it cannot instruct the scraper itself. To shape the output with a JSON schema, append it to the prompt as a Json Schema: section. Defaults to "Extract all data as complete as possible."

arguments.name: screenshot
arguments.desc: Captures a screenshot of the rendered page as a base64-encoded image. Useful for verifying what the scraper actually saw. Off by default.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.desc: Maximum seconds to wait for the scrape before the request times out, from 1 to 330. Increase for slow or complex pages. Defaults to 300.

arguments.name: waitForSelector
arguments.desc: Waits until a specific CSS selector or text appears on the page before returning it, such as #results. Up to 500 characters. Useful for content that loads asynchronously after the initial page load.

arguments.name: warmStart
arguments.desc: Opens the site's home page first to warm the session before loading the target URL. Useful for sites that expect a normal browsing session before deeper pages.

name: webSearch
description: Search the web and return ranked results with titles, URLs, descriptions, and sources.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: The search query, from 1 to 1000 characters.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: Two-letter country code to run the search from. Defaults to the United States.

arguments.name: numResults
arguments.desc: How many results to return, from 10 to 100. The search may return fewer. Defaults to 10.
